ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name Settlr (Settlr Fintech Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.settlr.example
Location Mumbai, Maharashtra
Incorporated April 2023
One-line description Payments and invoice financing for Indian SMEs.
Sector (as selected) Fintech
Stage (as selected) Series A
Team size 31
Founders
Founder 1 Rahul Mehta, CEO. 10 years in transaction banking; led SME product at
a private bank. linkedin.com/in/rahul-mehta-example
Founder 2 Sonal Iyer, CTO. 8 years in payments engineering at a large fintech.
linkedin.com/in/sonal-iyer-example
Time commitment Both full-time since 2023.
Prior startup experience None.
Equity split Founders 58%, seed investors 30%, ESOP 12%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A payments platform for SMEs with payment links, collections
reconciliation and invoice financing funded by NBFC partners.
Customers 1,150 SMEs.
Volume and revenue INR 86 Cr payment volume in October 2026. Net revenue INR 78 L.
Unit economics CAC INR 14,500 per SME, payback 7 months, gross margin 58%, net
revenue retention 112%.
Customer acquisition CA and accountant partners 40%, direct sales 35%, inbound and
referrals 25%.
Key risks Credit losses on financed invoices, dependence on NBFC partners,
regulation of digital lending.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 30 Cr

Valuation expectation INR 180 Cr post-money
Existing investors INR 9 Cr seed round in 2024, led by two institutional funds.
Use of funds Financing book, sales and distribution, product, risk and compliance.
Other investors in
conversation
Four Series A funds.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We are looking for a lead investor for our Series A.
